title: ArBanking77-Verify v0.1.0
description: A compact reference implementation for benchmark-state identity and historical compatibility verification. The software binds declared states to immutable source identifiers, fails closed on identity or structural mismatches, performs multiplicity-preserving record comparison under a declared normalization ladder, and emits machine-readable evidence. No benchmark dataset bytes are redistributed in the software release.
